initiative.title: Wireframe content fidelity
initiative.summary: Represent content-heavy resume screens with multiline static copy, correct static semantics, spanning actions, and visible proposal marks.

sources.anchor: Resume display cannot represent multiline content well.
Below the flows in this project, add wireframes in this project.
Four resume review and evidence interview screens expose the content fidelity gaps.
The current model has text, textarea, cards, marks, and workbench slots.
Keep the wireframe DSL finite, source-backed, and separate from flow and overview semantics.

claims.statement: Static wireframe copy preserves intentional paragraph and bullet line breaks.
Static resume sections are not rendered as disabled controls.
A workbench can place one bottom action area across both columns.
Authored screen marks can be revealed with their reasons during review.
A project overview lists valid same-folder and explicitly linked wireframes without inventing capability relationships.
The change does not add rich text, arbitrary styles, coordinates, or resume-specific primitives.
Create the ticket graph and execute the ready work in this run.

shape.appetite: One focused DSL and renderer extension with no new dependency.
shape.problem: Content-heavy wireframes lose document structure, semantic accuracy, spanning actions, and authored change context.
shape.recommended_shape: Extend existing copy, card, frame, and mark mechanisms at narrow seams.
success_moves: Protect existing navigation and disclosure behavior.

first_proof.question: Can existing primitives represent a readable resume without rich text?
first_proof.artifact: A multiline static resume card parsed and rendered by the current viewer.
first_proof.decision_rule: Continue when line breaks remain visible and the static card is not a control; stop before adding rich text.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Dirty user-owned changes overlap renderer, CSS, documentation, fixtures, and tracker files.

fast_local_loop.slower_confirmation: pnpm test:dsl, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and clean browser inspection

milestones.title: Static resume content reads correctly
milestones.outcome: Multiline static resume content renders with correct semantics.
milestones.proof: Focused parser test and browser DOM inspection.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: All existing wireframes remain valid while multiline copy and static cards become more accurate.
milestones.rollback: Restore current escape handling and card renderer without a source migration.

milestones.title: Workbench actions span the screen
milestones.outcome: An optional footer spans the workbench.
milestones.proof: Parser test and browser layout inspection.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Frames without footer content keep their current layout.
milestones.rollback: Remove the optional footer slot; existing sources remain valid.

milestones.title: Authored changes are visible
milestones.outcome: Existing marks appear in an optional annotated review mode.
milestones.proof: Focused state test and browser inspection.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: The normal mockup remains unchanged when annotation mode is off.
milestones.rollback: Remove the review toggle and mark presentation while preserving parsed mark data.

milestones.title: The overview lists project wireframes
milestones.outcome: A wireframe shelf appears below the project flow shelf.
milestones.proof: Pure inventory tests and a clean overview browser inspection.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: The existing flow shelf and capability-linked wireframe navigation remain available.
milestones.rollback: Remove the sibling shelf and projection without changing catalog or overview source semantics.

history.event: Created a focused delivery plan from the resume wireframe audit and repository evidence.
